name: LGMS
recent: LGMS 在 2026 年 11 月公布第三季业绩，营收 960 万令吉，净利同比减半至 112.5 万令吉，未派息。公司同时推出五项 AI 网络安全方案，并持续有董事及大股东在公开市场买卖股份。
notable: Q3 2026 营收 960 万令吉，净利同比减半至 112.5 万令吉，未宣布派息。
公司推出五项 AI 网络安全解决方案。
多名董事及大股东在 9 月至 10 月期间申报买卖公司股份。
risks: 董事及大股东在公开市场进行股份买卖，包括独立非执行董事 Dato' Dr Lim Joo Soon 于 10 月 23 日以每股 0.49 令吉增持 20,000 股。
非独立非执行董事 Dr Lim Pang Kiam 于 9 月 29 日以每股 0.51 令吉增持 100,000 股。
执行董事 Miss Goh Soon Sei 与董事经理 Mr Fong Choong Fook 在 10 月申报在闭市期间有买卖意向。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收 1,006.8 万令吉，环比下降 7.3%，同比微增 0.4%；净利 174.8 万令吉，环比下降 20.5%，同比下降 13.7%；净利率 17.4%，低于上一季度的 20.2%。

recent_en: LGMS reported Q3 2026 revenue of RM9.6 million with net profit halving year-on-year to RM1.125 million, and no dividend was declared. The company also launched five AI cybersecurity solutions, while directors and major shareholders continued to trade shares in the open market.
notable_en: Q3 2026 revenue was RM9.6 million, net profit halved year-on-year to RM1.125 million, and no dividend was declared.
The company introduced five AI cybersecurity solutions.
Several directors and major shareholders reported share dealings between September and October.
risks_en: Directors and major shareholders traded shares in the open market, including Independent Non-Executive Director Dato' Dr Lim Joo Soon acquiring 20,000 shares at RM0.49 each on 23 October.
Non-Independent Non-Executive Director Dr Lim Pang Kiam acquired 100,000 shares at RM0.51 each on 29 September.
Executive Director Miss Goh Soon Sei and Managing Director Mr Fong Choong Fook declared intentions to deal during the closed period in October.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM10.068 million, down 7.3% QoQ and up 0.4% YoY; net profit was RM1.748 million, down 20.5% QoQ and down 13.7% YoY; net margin was 17.4%, lower than 20.2% in the previous quarter.
